Script.name: PrintDataSummary
Script.label: Print Data Summary
Script.tooltip: Prints the number of points and cells of the active source.

Category.Script:
from paraview.simple import GetActiveSource
source = GetActiveSource() if source is None: print("No active source.") else: info = source.GetDataInformation() print("%d points, %d cells" % (info.GetNumberOfPoints(), info.GetNumberOfCells()))
